description: This file defines the JobTitleDao class responsible for database access and data operations related to job titles within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and querying job title data, including related entities such as job specifications and attachments.

classes.name: JobTitleDao
classes.description: DAO class providing methods for managing JobTitle entities, including CRUD operations and filtering for the Human Resource Management system.

methods.name: getJobTitleList
methods.description: Returns a list of active job titles, ordered by name.

methods.name: getJobTitlesForEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves job titles associated with a specific employee number.

methods.name: getJobTitles
methods.description: Fetches job titles based on search filter parameters with optional pagination.

methods.name: getJobTitlesPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator object for job title queries based on filters.

methods.name: getJobTitlesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of job titles matching the provided filters.

methods.name: deleteJobTitle
methods.description: Marks job titles as deleted by setting isDeleted flag.

methods.name: getJobTitleById
methods.description: Fetches a job title by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingJobTitleIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of existing job titles from a list of IDs.

methods.name: getJobSpecAttachmentById
methods.description: Retrieves a job specification attachment by its ID.

methods.name: saveJobTitle
methods.description: Persists a JobTitle entity to the database.

methods.name: getJobSpecificationByJobTitleId
methods.description: Retrieves a partial job specification attachment associated with a specific job title.
